{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hurt Vectors''' were a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] that was known for terrorizing the lowest levels of [[Vandalar City]]. A [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was placed on each member of the gang. They used a seventh floor room as their hideout, with their [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] stored in a garage one level below. They were captured by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who delivered them to the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]].
